hero.title: About Huateng Group
hero.subtitle: Years of dedication to study abroad education, trusted by students for our expertise and integrity

background.title: Our Background
background.description: Founded in 2020, Huateng Group is a premium and professional study abroad education group. The group specializes in undergraduate and postgraduate study abroad applications, with particularly deep expertise and an outstanding reputation in Hong Kong bachelor's degree admissions. Over the years, Huateng Group has consistently upheld a student-centered service philosophy, helping over 100 students successfully enter the world's top universities, with acceptance rates consistently leading the industry.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.intro: Since its founding, Huateng Group has regarded "empowering students" as its foundation. We have cultivated deep expertise in education, assembling a team of senior study abroad consultants, overseas returnee scholars, and international course instructors. They are not only industry experts but also individuals who have walked this path themselves, deeply understanding every challenge and aspiration along the educational journey.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become the world's leading study abroad education service group, building bridges to prestigious universities for students around the globe.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To help every student achieve their dream of attending a prestigious university, providing the most professional and caring academic planning and application services.
